findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11(C) Equipment Food-Contact Surfaces and Utensils. (C) Except as specified in (D) of this section, if used with TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD, EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be cleaned throughout the day at least every 4 hours.

Two meat slicers were observed with remaining food debris. When asked, the employee indicated that neither had been used that day, meaning that they had not been properly cleaned/sanitized after the prior use. The employee was shown and disassembled the two slicers for recleaning. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are cleaned regularly/as needed to maintain food safety standards.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.citation_text:
3-304.12(C) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored:(C) On a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food-contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency specified under §§ 4-602.11 and 4-702.11.

A knife was observed in the deli area in contact with a notebook. Paper products are not generally cleanable or able to be sanitized. The PIC was shown and the situation discussed. The knife was moved to dish for re-cleaning to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that all in use utensils are stored between uses in such a way so as to be protected from possible contamination.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

Two coffee tumblers and an open Monster energy drink were observed in a shelving unit next to plastic containers used for food service. The PIC was shown and removed the open drinks to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that employee foods and drinks are stored seperately from any foods or food contact surfaces intended for consumers.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

1) Multiple ceiling tiles in the meat area are observed damaged and in need of replacing. The PIC indicated that they have spares stored in the back and that they would be replaced. 2) The exit handle to the meat room walk in cooler leading into the back-stock area of the facility is damaged/missing. The PIC was shown and instructed to repair/replace prior to the next routine inspection.  Ensure that all facilities are maintained in good repair at all times.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

An employee was observed to change gloves without hand washing. Education was conducted and the PIC is instructed to ensure that all employee are educated on safe hand washing practices. Wash hands prior to putting on or changing gloves.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

Gloves were observed being changed during this inspection without hand washing taking place. Education was conducted to correct. The PIC is instructed to review hand washing practices with food handlers and ensure that hand washing is taking place at all times that it should.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The opening inside of the ice machine that transfers ice into the main storage compartment has numerous black mold spots and a milky substance observed hanging down. The item was cleaned during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. 

The display reach in cooler in the cold deli area currently has tape holding the left door handle to the door. Tape is generally not considered a smooth and easily cleanable surface and should not be used in repair practices near food or moisture. This door should be repaired/replaced with smooth and easily cleanable materials. Repair/replace prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

Minor cleaning is needed in multiple locations throughout the permit: 1) under/along the edge of the grill area used for take out orders in the deli area; 2) in corners on the shelves in the butcher walk in cooler and; 3) in the cracks of the heat wrapping equipment. Ensure that these areas are cleaned often enough to ensure that food debris does not accumulate.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

The hand sink in the butcher area is without paper towels during this inspection. Paper towels were supplied during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The opening inside of the ice machine that transfers ice into the main storage compartment has numerous black mold spots observed. Follow up Tuesday because of the holiday on Monday.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

Multiple packages of meats and cheeses in the open faced end cap cooler are observed with internal temperatures between 45F-56F depending on where in the cooler they are located. The PIC was consulted and the out of temperature foods were discarded to correct the violation.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures. 

The end cap open faced cooler holding meat and cheeses is observed to not hold all of the foods at the correct temperature. Follow up in two weeks for compliance.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed. 

Several spreaders being stored in a container that has a significant amount of food debris in the bottom. The container and the utensils were moved to dish for cleaning.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Back deli handsink observed without paper towels. CORRECTED— Paper towels provided.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. [Pf]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Sandwich-- In the prep cooler, cucumbers, jalapenos, and leaf & shredded lettuce observed to be marked 7/18. CORRECTED-- Voluntarily discarded.
Meat-- In the walk-in cooler, stuffed mushrooms observed dated 7/20. CORRECTED-- Voluntarily discarded.
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

Observed sani bucket in the coleslaw prep making area to be 100 ppm. Changed bucket - 200 ppm. Facility has quat test strips to perform testing of concentration. Ensure sani buckets are changed every 4-6 hours or as needed to maintain a concentration of 200-400 ppm.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: Observed deli employee put on gloves without first washing hands. CORRECTED- Discussed proper glove use and handwashing habits with PIC.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD. (P)

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed deli handsink not to be functioning. CORRECTED- PIC replaced batteries in motion-sensor and handsink was observed to be functioning properly.
5-202.12 (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 38oC (100oF) through a mixing valve or combination faucet. (Pf)

Observed handsinks in the deli and butcher shop to be blocked. CORRECTED- PIC moved equipment to make handsinks easily accessible.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (Pf)

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment: Observed clean utensils stored in containers with crumbs and food debris and knife rack to be soiled with crumbs. Prevent contamination of clean utensils in storage and ensure clean utensils are stored in clean containers.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11 (A) Cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE USE ARTICLES shall be stored (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination. (C)

findings.title: Gloves used properly
findings.comment: Observed deli employee serve customers, adjust handsink, and return to serving customers without washing hands or changing gloves. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC and employee. Ensure that gloves are used for only one task and that gloves are changed when tasks are changed.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.15 (A) If used, SINGLE-USE gloves shall be used for only one task such as working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD or with raw animal FOOD, used for no other purpose, and discarded when damaged or soiled, or when interruptions occur in the operation. (P)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Observed a few vegetables spilled on the floor in the meat walk-in cooler. Observed food debris in a grocery cooler under packaged chorizo. Surfaces must be cleaned as frequently as necessary to prevent soil accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. (C)
